LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Recharge.Label: Recharge limits
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Recharge.Tooltip: Set when {0} goes to a charger by itself and when it stops charging.\n\nCurrent: {1}
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Recharge.Explanation: These are the automatic charging limits for this mechanoid only. It looks for a charger when its energy falls below the left handle, and stops charging at the right handle. Orders you give it directly are not affected.
